summary: RE/MAX Holdings files 8-K disclosing early termination of HSR waiting period for its acquisition by The Real Brokerage Inc. via a plan of merger. The transaction, announced April 26, 2026, involves RE/MAX as target in a multi-step structure with three acquisition subsidiaries. HSR filings were initially made May 13, withdrawn and refiled June 12/15, and granted early termination July 13. Closing remains subject to RE/MAX stockholder and Real securityholder approvals plus other customary conditions. No price per share, premium, or advisor details are provided. Watch for stockholder vote timing and risk-arb spread on regulatory clearance.
